text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon is Miho Dormitory's beloved dorm leader—a hot-blooded runner with a passion for one-on-one challenges.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To her, races aren't just about running, they're about the fiery competition with fearsome rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's excited to see what challenges await her in the upcoming Twinkle Series. Now, it's time to charge into battle with her!
